items.example: Their new phone really breaks the mould.
items.exampleTr: Yeni telefonları gerçekten kalıpları kırıyor.
items.simple: Do something in a new way that nobody did before.
dialogue: A: Why do you like this café so much?
B: It doesn't try to break the mould. It just does great coffee.
items.note: 'They broke the mould when they made him' = eşi benzeri yok.

items.example: Her opinion carries a lot of weight around here.
items.exampleTr: Burada onun fikrinin çok ağırlığı var.
items.simple: People listen to it because it is important.
dialogue: A: Should I ask Ahmet to back me up?
B: Yes, his word will carry weight with the director.
items.note: Söz, fikir, tavsiye için; 'carries a lot of weight'.

items.example: He spent years trying to clear his name.
items.exampleTr: Adını temize çıkarmak için yıllarca uğraştı.
items.simple: Show everyone you did not do the bad thing.
dialogue: A: They think I took the money from the till.
B: Then check the cameras and clear your name.
items.note: Haksız suçlamaya karşı aklanmak için.

items.example: He's always trying to curry favour with the new manager.
items.exampleTr: Sürekli yeni müdürün gözüne girmeye çalışıyor.
items.simple: Try to make someone important like you, to get something.
dialogue: A: Why did she bring cakes for the boss?
B: She's trying to curry favour before the reviews.
items.note: Olumsuz anlam; genelde 'curry favour with someone'.

items.example: I didn't want to sack him, but he forced my hand.
items.exampleTr: Onu kovmak istemiyordum ama elim mahkum kaldı.
items.simple: Someone makes you do something before you are ready.
dialogue: A: Why did you call the police on the neighbours?
B: I had no choice. They decided to force my hand.
items.note: Biri seni istemediğin bir karara itince.

items.example: I applied to five universities to hedge my bets.
items.exampleTr: Garantiye almak için beş üniversiteye başvurdum.
items.simple: Choose more than one thing so you don't lose everything.
dialogue: A: Why bring an umbrella and sunglasses?
B: With British weather, it's smart to hedge your bets.
items.note: Tek seçeneğe güvenmemek için.

items.example: Maybe this photo will jog your memory.
items.exampleTr: Belki bu fotoğraf aklına bir şeyler getirir.
items.simple: Help someone remember something.
dialogue: A: I don't remember meeting her.
B: She was at Ali's wedding. Does that jog your memory?
items.note: Birinin unuttuğu bir şeyi hatırlatırken.

items.example: He said he was ill to save face.
items.exampleTr: Rezil olmamak için hasta olduğunu söyledi.
items.simple: Do something so people won't laugh at you or think less of you.
dialogue: A: Why did he say he quit? He was fired.
B: He's just trying to save face.
items.note: Karşıtı 'lose face' = itibar kaybetmek.

items.example: We're finally making headway with the kitchen.
items.exampleTr: Mutfakta nihayet yol alıyoruz.
items.simple: Move forward with something that was slow or hard.
dialogue: A: How's the job hunt going?
B: Slowly, but I think I'm starting to make headway.
items.note: Zor bir işte ilerleme için; genelde 'make some headway'.

items.example: Let's not muddy the waters with another option.
items.exampleTr: Bir seçenek daha ekleyip ortalığı bulandırmayalım.
items.simple: Make a simple thing confusing.
dialogue: A: Should I mention the other offer too?
B: No, that will only muddy the waters.
items.note: Tartışmayı kasıtlı ya da kasıtsız karıştırmak için.

items.example: He's in bed nursing a hangover.
items.exampleTr: Yatakta akşamdan kalmalığını atlatmaya çalışıyor.
items.simple: Rest and feel sick the day after drinking too much.
dialogue: A: Coming to brunch?
B: I'll pass. I need to stay in bed and nurse a hangover.
items.note: Gündelik ve esprili; 'nurse a cold/a drink' da denir.

items.example: My cousin came for a week and stayed a month. He overstayed his welcome.
items.exampleTr: Kuzenim bir haftalığına geldi, bir ay kaldı. Misafirliği fazla uzattı.
items.simple: Stay at someone's place for too long, so they get tired of you.
dialogue: A: How long should I stay at their place?
B: A weekend's plenty. You don't want to overstay your welcome.
items.note: Misafirlik ya da bir yerde fazla oyalanmak için.

items.tr: lafta destek vermek, laf olsun diye söylemek
items.example: They pay lip service to work-life balance, but everyone works till nine.
items.exampleTr: İş-özel hayat dengesine lafta destek veriyorlar ama herkes dokuza kadar çalışıyor.
items.simple: Say you support something, but do nothing for it.
dialogue: A: The company says it cares about mental health.
B: They just pay lip service to it.
items.note: Şirketlerin ve siyasetçilerin içi boş sözleri için.

items.example: He always picks a fight when he's had a few drinks.
items.exampleTr: Birkaç kadeh içince hep kavga çıkarır.
items.simple: Start an argument or fight on purpose.
dialogue: A: Why are you criticising my shoes now?
B: I'm not trying to pick a fight, I promise.
items.note: Kasten tartışma başlatan biri için.

items.example: If everyone pulls their weight, we'll finish by six.
items.exampleTr: Herkes üzerine düşeni yaparsa altıda bitiririz.
items.simple: Do your fair part of the work.
dialogue: A: Why is Sam so annoyed with me?
B: He thinks you don't pull your weight on the team.
items.note: Ekip işi veya ev işleri paylaşımında.

items.example: His holiday photos raised a few eyebrows at work.
items.exampleTr: Tatil fotoğrafları iş yerinde bazılarının kaşlarını kaldırttı.
items.simple: Make people surprised or a bit shocked.
dialogue: A: She wore pyjamas to the meeting?
B: Yes, and it did raise eyebrows.
items.note: Hafif skandal veya tuhaf davranış için.

items.example: Let me set the record straight: I never said that.
items.exampleTr: Şu yanlışı düzelteyim: Ben öyle bir şey hiç söylemedim.
items.simple: Tell people the true story after a wrong one went around.
dialogue: A: Everyone thinks you're moving to Berlin.
B: I need to set the record straight. I'm only visiting.
items.note: Dedikodu veya yanlış bilgiye karşı.

items.example: The best man's speech stole the show.
items.exampleTr: Sağdıcın konuşması gecenin yıldızı oldu.
items.simple: Be the best or most loved part of an event.
dialogue: A: How was the school play?
B: Our little one managed to steal the show!
items.note: Beklenmedik biri öne çıkınca.

items.example: That song really struck a chord with me.
items.exampleTr: O şarkı gerçekten içime dokundu.
items.simple: Something makes you feel strong feelings because it feels true for you.
dialogue: A: Why do people love that ad so much?
B: I think it manages to strike a chord with parents.
items.note: Duygusal yankı uyandıran şeyler için.

items.example: After the divorce, I took some time to take stock of my life.
items.exampleTr: Boşanmadan sonra hayatımı gözden geçirmek için biraz zaman ayırdım.
items.simple: Stop and think carefully about where you are now.
dialogue: A: Are you going to look for a new job right away?
B: No, first I want to take stock.
items.note: Genelde 'take stock of something'.

items.example: I'll mention it casually to test the waters.
items.exampleTr: Nabız yoklamak için laf arasında söyleyeceğim.
items.simple: Try something small first to see how people react.
dialogue: A: Should I ask for a four-day week?
B: Bring it up in a chat first to test the waters.
items.note: Büyük bir adımdan önce tepkiyi görmek için.

items.example: If you want to keep this job, you'll have to toe the line.
items.exampleTr: Bu işte kalmak istiyorsan hizaya girmen gerekecek.
items.simple: Do what the rules or the boss say, even if you don't like it.
dialogue: A: Why didn't you argue with the new policy?
B: It's easier to toe the line until my contract's renewed.
items.note: Otoriteye boyun eğmeyi anlatır; 'tow' değil 'toe' yazılır.

items.example: The receptionist bent the rules and let us check in early.
items.exampleTr: Resepsiyonist kuralları esnetip erken giriş yapmamıza izin verdi.
items.simple: Do something a bit against the rules, but not very bad.
dialogue: A: Can I bring my dog into the office?
B: Officially no, but we can bend the rules on Fridays.
items.note: 'break the rules'dan daha hafif.

items.example: The company footed the bill for our team dinner.
items.exampleTr: Ekip yemeğimizin masrafını şirket üstlendi.
items.simple: Pay for something, often something big.
dialogue: A: Who's paying for the wedding?
B: Her parents offered to foot the bill.
items.note: Genelde bir başkası veya kurum ödediğinde.

items.example: Some guy tried to jump the queue at the bakery.
items.exampleTr: Fırında adamın biri sıraya kaynak yapmaya çalıştı.
items.simple: Go in front of people who were waiting before you.
dialogue: A: Excuse me, we've been waiting twenty minutes.
B: Sorry, I didn't mean to jump the queue.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; Amerikanca 'cut in line'.
